problemSignature.failureMode: candidate search used KiCad DRC as the only prefilter and hit runtime limits

rootCause: BoardForge treated a clean compact fallback as REV_F completion while the true outline-aware placement board still had exact KiCad unconnected items. The first exact finishers also used representative DRC positions instead of resolving KiCad pad/track UUIDs to actual endpoints, and they lacked commit checkpointing.
fixSummary: Separate fallback manufacturing candidates from unfinished outline-aware boards. Add clearance-aware exact finisher planning that resolves DRC UUID endpoints, prefilters candidates with an obstacle map, commits only when KiCad connectivity improves with zero DRC, and checkpoints after every safe route.

testsAdded: clearance-aware exact finisher resolves KiCad UUID endpoints and checkpoints productive runs
REV_F true outline-aware board requires exact finisher until connectivity is clean

conditions: FreeRouting leaves a small exact ratsnest tail
DRC is clean but unconnected items remain
fallback route exists but product-shape route is not complete

recipe: Run KiCad DRC and parse unconnected_items.
Resolve each DRC item UUID to its actual pad or track endpoint.
Build a local obstacle map before generating route candidates.
Spend KiCad DRC only on candidates that pass geometric prefiltering.
Commit only when global unconnected decreases and DRC remains zero.
Checkpoint after every safe commit so long exact finishing can resume.
safetyRules: Do not call a fallback board the same as the unfinished outline-aware board.
Do not export manufacturing for a board with unconnected items.
Do not count added segments as success.
Do not route with blind, buried, micro, or via-in-pad vias.
